session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Weak Trend Resumption Up'; filename 'bull trend resumption after FOMC 3'. Chart is the day after a FOMC release (inset sliver 12:30-13:00 of the previous day, dotted separator, 12/11 edge marker): early bear drift to 3128, parabolic wedge (drawn magenta dotted rising line) topping 3142.5 with sell-off, mid-morning wedge retest at 3138.5 with red signal boxes, a drawn red horizontal reference line at 3136 (09:30-10:45) and a tight pre-FOMC range 3134-3135.5, then a blue-arrow 'FOMC' break at 11:00 launching the weak bullish resumption to 3145.5 (drawn rising channel 11:15-12:10), an afternoon pullback to the channel low 3138.5 (red boxes) and recovery to about 3143 into the close. Axis prints 07:00-13:00 with 12/11 -> 12/12 edge markers (offset-style).
